component.name: Smokenot
component.summary: A small offline companion for leaving the cigarette behind

description.p: Smokenot keeps a count of the days, the money and the cigarettes you did not smoke, and puts a five minute breathing session next to you when a craving shows up. It also keeps a short journal of cravings and slips, so you can see your own pattern instead of guessing at it.
Everything is written to one file in your own home directory. The app asks for no network, no account and no telemetry, and it works with the machine offline.
The counters are a way to notice your own progress. They are not medical advice and they are not a diagnosis of anything.

O Smokenot conta os dias, o dinheiro e os cigarros que você não fumou, e coloca uma sessão de respiração de cinco minutos ao lado quando a vontade aparece. Também guarda um diário curto de vontades e recaídas, para você ver o seu próprio padrão em vez de adivinhar.
Tudo fica num arquivo dentro da sua pasta pessoal. O app não pede rede, conta nem telemetria, e funciona com o computador desligado da internet.
First version: the days and money counters, the breathing session, the journal and the settings.
